user.title: EDF Usage
user.description:
Connect your EDF electricity account.

1. Sign in to [EDF MyAccount]({myaccount_url}) and copy your account number from your account or a bill.
2. Paste your EDF account-user API key below. This lets the integration obtain and renew access tokens automatically. If you do not have a key, contact EDF about API access.

**Temporary browser token**

In a desktop browser, open Developer tools > Network > Fetch/XHR while signed in to MyAccount. Reload your usage page and look for a request to `api.edfgb-kraken.energy` containing `graphql`. In Request headers, copy the `Authorization` value if it contains a Kraken token beginning with `eyJ` (it may have a `Bearer` prefix). Paste it below.

A browser token expires and cannot be renewed by this integration; you will need to reconnect with a fresh token. If no such header is visible, see the [credential guide]({setup_help_url}).

Automatic browser sign-in needs an [OAuth application approved by EDF]({oauth_help_url}); it is not available in this integration yet.

data_description.api_token: An account-user API key is recommended. A temporary Kraken token must be replaced when it expires. Treat either credential like a password.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect EDF Usage
reauth_confirm.description:
EDF rejected the saved credential, or your temporary access token expired. Enter a current EDF account-user API key or a fresh Kraken access token.

**Get a fresh browser token**

1. Sign in to [EDF MyAccount]({myaccount_url}) in a desktop browser.
2. Open Developer tools > Network > Fetch/XHR, then reload your usage page.
3. Look for a request to `api.edfgb-kraken.energy` containing `graphql`. In Request headers, copy the `Authorization` value if it contains a Kraken token beginning with `eyJ` (it may have a `Bearer` prefix), then paste it below.

Browser tokens expire and cannot be renewed by this integration. An EDF account-user API key lets the integration renew access tokens automatically; contact EDF about API access if you need one. See the [credential guide]({setup_help_url}) for help.

Automatic browser sign-in requires an [OAuth application approved by EDF]({oauth_help_url}) and is not available in this integration yet.
